speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or visible blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any chills, nausea, or pain radiating to your groin? Also, tell me about your urine: is it cloudy, foul-smelling, or bloody?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: That allergic reaction to amoxicillin is important; did the flank pain begin before or after starting the cephalexin, and does it worsen when you shake your leg? I also need to know if you are passing any blood in your urine. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, CBC.
